title: Dealer order type file (Finspot OMS, Dealer – Order Type Enable)
purpose: The order types each dealer login may place. Ledgerline does not hold Finspot's dealer logins, so the dealer IDs and the order types (LMT, MKT, SL-LMT, SL-MKT, DS by default, as Finspot's sample lists them) are firm settings in Connections → Finspot uploads; one line per dealer ID.

columns.name: OrderType
columns.note: Comma-separated: LMT, MKT, SL-LMT, SL-MKT, DS

linked: Front office → Finspot uploads (dealer order types)
source: Finspot File_Formats.xlsx, sheet Dealer – Order Type Enable (2 columns, NOT NULL)
